title: Privacy Policy
intro: Welcome to Visit Museums ("we," "our," or "us"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website. By using our website, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 1. Who We Are
sections.content: Visit Museums is an independent travel information website that provides guides, visitor information, travel tips, and ticket comparisons for museums, galleries, and cultural attractions around the world. We do not sell tickets directly. We participate in affiliate marketing programs. When you click certain links and make a purchase through our affiliate partners, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.content: Information you voluntarily provide includes your name, email address, information submitted through contact forms, and any information you voluntarily send us. We also automatically collect certain information when you visit our site, including your IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, pages visited, time spent on pages, referring website, and the date and time of your visit.

sections.heading: 3. Cookies
sections.content: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, improve website performance, analyze website traffic, measure marketing effectiveness, and support affiliate tracking.

sections.heading: 4. Affiliate Links
sections.content: Some links on our website are affiliate links. If you purchase through these links, we may earn a commission at no additional cost to you. Affiliate partners may include GetYourGuide, Viator, Headout, Tiqets, and other travel booking platforms.

sections.heading: 5. Analytics
sections.content: We may use analytics services such as Google Analytics or similar tools to understand how visitors use our website.

sections.heading: 6. Advertising
sections.content: We may display advertisements from third-party advertising partners.

sections.heading: 7. Third-Party Websites
sections.content: Our website contains links to third-party websites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing any personal information or completing a booking.

sections.heading: 8. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use information to operate our website, respond to inquiries, improve user experience, analyze website performance, detect fraud and security issues, comply with legal obligations, and support affiliate tracking and reporting.

sections.heading: 9. Sharing Your Information
sections.content: We do not sell your personal information. Information may be shared with analytics providers, affiliate partners, hosting providers, technical service providers, or legal authorities when required by law.

sections.heading: 10. Data Security
sections.content: We implement reasonable measures to protect your information, although no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

sections.heading: 11. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain personal information only as long as necessary for legal and operational purposes.

sections.heading: 12. Your Rights
sections.content: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict processing, object to processing, request data portability, and withdraw consent regarding your personal information.

sections.heading: 13. Children's Privacy
sections.content: Our website is not directed toward children under 13 years of age.

sections.heading: 14. International Visitors
sections.content: Your information may be processed in countries with different data protection laws than your own.

sections.heading: 15. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

sections.heading: 16. Contact Us
sections.content: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Email us at adnanravendigimark@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Affiliate Disclosure
sections.content: Visit Museums is an independent travel guide and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or operated by the Louvre Museum, the Uffizi Gallery, the Opera di Santa Maria del Fiore, Lindt & Sprüngli, or any of their management or official tourism authorities. Some links are affiliate links, meaning we may earn a commission if you make a purchase through them at no additional cost to you.
